reader.requirement: At --std 85, in a format-2 OCCURS integer-1 TO integer-2 TIMES DEPENDING ON data-name-1 entry, the compiler must refuse integer-1 below zero and integer-2 not greater than integer-1, and accept integer-1 of zero with integer-2 greater (zero is explicitly allowed for integer-1, overriding §1985:III.2's nonzero default).

edition-consulted.switches: IntegerSlot.At(dialectLevel): the zero-permission of an integer slot; OccursBound returns IntegerSlot.Zero with no edition floor, so integer-1 may be zero at every edition
the wording of the zero-integer refusal: §1985:III.2 below 2002, §2023:5.5 from 2002 (message text only)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/Version/1985/Occurs in OdoResolvePass.cs, IntegerOperandPass.cs, VersionConformancePass.cs (VisitOccursClause gates only OCCURS DYNAMIC and report OCCURS); the SR5 check itself in OdoResolvePass#Run is unconditional.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f07_05 refuses integer-2 equal to integer-1 and g85_f07_06 accepts integer-1 of zero; integer-1 greater than integer-2 and a signed integer-1 are not exercised

probes.printed: error COBOL0850: OCCURS 5 TO 3 on 'WS-EL': integer-1 shall be greater than or equal to zero and less than integer-2
probes.expected: refused: integer-2 must be greater than integer-1

probes.printed: error COBOL0001 / COBOL1941 unexpected '-' at OCCURS -1 TO 3
error COBOL2386 (integer-2 of 0 shall be nonzero, §1985:III.2) and COBOL0850 for OCCURS 0 TO 0

probes.expected: accepted; group length follows the counter

probes.printed: error COBOL2789: integer-1 TO integer-2 written without DEPENDING ON
probes.expected: refused: integer-1 TO appears only in format 2, which requires DEPENDING ON

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR5  (5.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5
OK  §1985:III.2  (2. <u>DEFINITIONS</u>)  the text is in the clause

reader.notes: OdoResolvePass#Run refuses spec.Min < 0 || spec.Min >= spec.Max at every edition (COBOL0850); a minus sign never parses as an integer; IntegerOperandPass#OccursBound lets integer-1 be zero. The COBOL0850 message cites §2023:13.18.38.3 SR16 rather than the 1985 rule at --std 85 (wording only). The ReportSectionBinder seed is irrelevant at 1985: report OCCURS first exists at 2002 (VersionConformancePass gates it).

refuter.evidence: cite.py: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR5  the text is in SR5. Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-209/runs: r1 OCCURS +0 TO 3 DEPENDING refused (COBOL0001/COBOL1941 at '+'; a signed integer is not an integer per the 1985 definition); r5 OCCURS 1 TO +3 refused (COBOL0001); r4 OCCURS 3 TO 3.0 refused (COBOL5506 non-integer literal); r2 OCCURS 3 TIMES DEPENDING ON (2002-style omitted integer-1, which the 1985 format-2 prints as required) refused COBOL2789; r3 OCCURS 1 TO 3 DEPENDING ON (counter 2) ran and printed '[  ]' (two-character group). No form SR5 governs was mis-handled.
